name: New Zealand

flag.description: A dark blue field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist and four red five-pointed stars with white borders in the fly, forming the Southern Cross.
flag.symbolism: The Union Jack reflects New Zealand's historical ties to Britain and the Southern Cross its location in the South Pacific.

hook: New Zealand: four red stars outlined in white and nothing under the Union Jack; Australia has white stars, five in its Southern Cross plus a big one below the Jack.
trivia: In a 2016 referendum about 57% of voters chose to keep the current flag over a silver fern design.
The flag's Southern Cross has four stars, leaving out the small fifth star that appears on Australia's.
In 1893 New Zealand became the first self-governing country to give women the vote in national elections.
